qe: In January 1784 the erection of the great granary at Bankipore was sanctioned as one result of measures which included the removal of transit duties on grain and the cancelling of the order prohibiting export of grain from which two districts?
qh: जनवरी 1784 में बांकीपुर के महान अनाज-भंडार के निर्माण की स्वीकृति उन उपायों के एक परिणाम के रूप में मिली, जिनमें अनाज पर आने-जाने का शुल्क हटाना तथा किन दो जिलों से अनाज के निर्यात पर लगी रोक रद्द करना शामिल था?
e: 1783 me Patna kshetra me akal ka bhay phir se jaga tatha usi daur me John Shore ne ek yojna rakhi, jisme anya kadmon ke saath yah bhi shamil tha ki anaaj par lagne wale aane-jaane ke shulk yaani transit duties hata di jayein tatha Saran tatha Tirhut se anaaj ke niryat par lagai gayi rok radd kar di jaye. In upayon se anaaj ka aana-jaana aasan hua aur akal ke samay kshetra me anaaj pahunch paya. Inhi sujhaavon ka ek parinaam yah nikla ki Bankipore me bada anaj-bhandar yaani Golghar banane ki swikriti January 1784 me mil gayi tatha 1786 me imarat taiyar ho gayi. Aisa bhandar banane ki soch 1770 tatha 1783 ki tanqidi ki yaad dilati hai, jab bhookh se hazaaron logon ki maut hui thi. Exam point: anaaj par transit duty hatana tatha Saran-Tirhut se niryat ki rok radd karna John Shore ke 1783 ke upayon me shamil tha; Bankipore ke bade anaj-bhandar (Golghar) ki swikriti January 1784 me mili tatha imarat 1786 me ban kar taiyar hui.

qe: In July 1787 the office of Revenue Chief was abolished and Thomas Law became Collector of which district, with its headquarters at Gaya?
qh: जुलाई 1787 में रेवेन्यू चीफ का पद समाप्त कर दिया गया तथा थॉमस लॉ किस जिले का कलेक्टर बना, जिसका मुख्यालय गया में था?
e: July 1787 me Company ne prashasan me ek bada badlav kiya tatha Revenue Chief ka pad hi samapt kar diya. Us samay Thomas Law 'district of Bihar' ke Collector bane; is jile ka kshetra prachin sarkar Bihar se milta tha tatha iska mukhyalay Gaya me tha. Is jile me aaj ke Patna tatha Gaya jile, Japla tatha Belaunja ke ilake bhi shamil the tatha pargane Kiul nadi tak phaile hue the. Yaad rahe ki us daur me jile ka roop aaj ke jilon se bahut alag tha; aaj ka Patna jila apni alag pehchan ke saath 1825 me banaya gaya. Thomas Law ka naam aage isliye bhi mahatvapurn hua ki unhone gaon ke malikon ke saath permanent settlement ka prayog kiya. Exam point: July 1787 me Revenue Chief ka pad samapt hua tatha Thomas Law 'district of Bihar' ke Collector bane jinka mukhyalay Gaya tha; is jile me aaj ke Patna-Gaya kshetra shamil the tatha pargane Kiul nadi tak pahaunchte the.

qe: In the temporarily settled area of the old Hasua zamindari, whose plan of making a permanent settlement with the village maliks was complimented by the Court of Directors in 1792?
qh: पुरानी हसुआ जमींदारी के अस्थायी रूप से बंदोबस्त वाले क्षेत्र में गाँव के मालिकों के साथ स्थायी बंदोबस्त करने की किसकी योजना की 1792 में कोर्ट ऑफ डायरेक्टर्स ने प्रशंसा की?
e: 1781 ke vidroh ke baad purani Hasua zamindari ke kshetra me ijaredaron ne lagan dena band kar diya tatha 1787 ke ant tak sabhi farmers bakaya kar gaye. Is par Thomas Law ne gaon ke malikon ke saath permanent settlement karne ki yojna banayi. Malikon ko zamindar banane ka ek fayda yah tha ki unki milkiyat aise logon ko rok degi jo purane zamindar ke naam par kabza karne ki koshish kar sakte the; iske alava permanent proprietor se yah ummeed thi ki woh sinchai tatha sudhar ke kaam me dhyan dega, jabki ijaredar aise kaam me kam ruchi lete the. 1783 se Law permanent settlement ki maang kar rahe the; Board of Revenue ne unki yojna ko manzoor nahi kiya, lekin 1792 me Court of Directors ne unke settlement ko permanent bana diya tatha unki sakriyata, jaankari tatha manavta ki prashansa ki. Exam point: Thomas Law ne Hasua zamindari ke kshetra me gaon ke malikon ke saath permanent settlement ki yojna banayi; malikon ko zamindari ka laabh unki milkiyat ko surakshit karta tha; 1792 me Court of Directors ne Law ke settlement ko permanent banaya tatha unki prashansa ki.

qe: The Decennial Settlement of the rest of the Patna district began in which year and was made permanent in 1793?
qh: पटना जिले के शेष भाग का दशवर्षीय बंदोबस्त किस वर्ष शुरू हुआ, जिसे 1793 में स्थायी बना दिया गया?
e: Thomas Law ke Hasua kshetra wale settlement ke baad jile ke shesh hisse ka bandobast alag kram me hua. Jile ke shesh bhaag ka Decennial Settlement yaani das-varsh ka bandobast 1789 me shuru hua tatha 1790 tak poora ho gaya; aage ise 1793 me permanent bana diya gaya. Kayi pargane zamindaron ke saath bandobast kiye gaye tatha kayi pargane gaon ke malikon ke saath; kuch pargane aise bhi the jo kisi ijaredar ko permanent patte par diye gaye the, lekin 1792 me unke bakaya karne par unhe bhi malikon ke saath bandobast kar diya gaya. Is tarah Patna kshetra me zamindari, malikana tatha rayat ki vyavastha likhit roop me tay hui, jo aage ki sadi me kshetra ki samajik tatha aarthik sthiti ka aadhaar bani. Exam point: Patna jile ke shesh bhaag ka Decennial Settlement 1789 me shuru hua tatha 1790 tak poora hua; 1793 me ise permanent bana diya gaya; kayi pargane zamindaron tatha gaon ke malikon ke saath bandobast huye.

qe: In 1790 the administration of criminal law in Patna district was definitely taken over by the Company from which authority?
qh: 1790 में पटना जिले में दंड-विधि का प्रशासन कंपनी ने किससे निश्चित रूप से अपने हाथ में ले लिया?
e: 1789 ke Decennial Settlement ke saath Patna kshetra me revenue tatha samanya prashasan ka naya daur shuru hua. 1790 me Company ne dand-vidhi yaani criminal law ka prashasan, jo ab tak Murshidabad ke Nawab-Nazim ke paas tha, nishchit roop se apne haath me le liya. Is badlav ke saath kuch purani tatha kathor sazayein bhi bandh ho gayin: ang-bhang ki saza yaani mutilation ab ek manya dand nahi rahi, bache hue dandon ki punah jaanch hui tatha yatana de kar bayan nikalne ki pratha ko rokne ki koshish ki gayi. Isi daur me Patna ka pehla Magistrate bhi niyukt hua tatha uske kshetra me shahar tatha Bankipore-Jaywar police circle shamil the. Exam point: 1790 me dand-vidhi ka prashasan Company ne Murshidabad ke Nawab-Nazim se apne haath me liya; ang-bhang (mutilation) ki saza bandh ho gayi, bache dandon ki punah jaanch hui tatha yatana se bayan lene ki pratha rokne ki koshish hui.

qe: Who was the first Magistrate of Patna, whose charge included only the city and the Bankipore-Jaywar police circle?
qh: पटना का पहला मजिस्ट्रेट कौन था, जिसके कार्यक्षेत्र में केवल शहर तथा बांकीपुर-जयवर पुलिस सर्कल था?
e: 1790 me dand-vidhi ka prashasan Company ke haath me aane ke baad Patna kshetra me Magistrate ka pad bana. Patna ka pehla Magistrate Charles Francis Grand tha, jiske kshetra me sirf shahar tatha Bankipore-Jaywar police circle shamil the; 1792 me uski jagah Henry Douglas ne li. Us daur me Gaya me baitha Magistrate Patna ke paas ki ghatnaon par theek samay par karwai nahi kar paata tha, isliye 1798 me Patna ke Magistrate ka kshetra badha kar chaar sau teen square mile kar diya gaya, jo Fatuha se Maner tak tatha dakshin me Naubatpur tak phaila tha. Aage 1825 me ek alag Patna jile ka nirman hua, jiske revenue tatha police dono seema ek hi tarah ki thi. Exam point: Patna ka pehla Magistrate Charles Francis Grand tha (1790), jiske kshetra me shahar tatha Bankipore-Jaywar circle shamil the; 1792 me Henry Douglas ne unki jagah li; 1798 me kshetra badh kar 403 square mile ho gaya.

qe: On the night of 1 February 1791, the camp of which unit was raided and looted at Jafar Khan's Bagh near Patna?
qh: 1 फरवरी 1791 की रात को पटना के निकट जाफर खान के बाग में किस यूनिट के शिविर पर डकैतों ने धावा बोलकर लूटपाट की?
e: Permanent settlement ke shuruaati saalon me Patna kshetra me daakoo tatha lutere bahut sakriy the. 1791 me ek bada aman ka bhagnaak ghatna hui: 1 February 1791 ki raat ko Jafar Khan ke Bagh me 32nd Native Infantry ke camp par dakaiton ne dhava bol kar lootpat ki. Us daur me dakoo giroh ka sambandh aksar sthanik darogaon se hota tha, isliye unhe pakadna mushkil tha. Fatuha se aage nadi ke raste se jahaz se yatra bhi khatarnak maani jaati thi, kyunki bina bhaari pahredari ke navon par hamla ho jaata tha. Jab dakoo giroh tutne lage, to thaggi yaani musafiron ko dhokha de kar maal lootne ki kala kshetra me sabse pramukh apradh ban gayi. Exam point: 1 February 1791 ki raat ko Jafar Khan ke Bagh (Patna) me 32nd Native Infantry ke camp par dakaiton ne hamla kar lootpat ki; us daur me darogaon tatha dakoo giroh ka sambandh aam baat thi; aage thaggi pramukh apradh bani.

qe: In 1798 the jurisdiction of the Magistrate at Patna was extended to cover how many square miles, from Fatuha to Maner?
qh: 1798 में पटना के मजिस्ट्रेट का अधिकार-क्षेत्र फतुहा से मनेर तक कितने वर्ग मील कर दिया गया?
e: Gaya me baithne wale Magistrate ke liye Patna kshetra ki ghatnaon par samay par karwai karna aasan nahi tha, kyunki dono ke beech kaafi doori thi. Isliye 1798 me Patna ke Magistrate ka adhikar-kshetra badha kar 403 square mile kar diya gaya; yah kshetra Fatuha se Maner tak phaila hua tha tatha dakshin me Naubatpur tak chala jaata tha. Is badlav se shahar tatha uske aas-paas ke ilake me apradhon par turant karwai karna aasan hua. Aage jab thaggi kshetra me badhi tatha Ganga road Fatuha ke purab wale hisse me yatree loote jaane lage, to 1825 me alag Patna jile ka nirman kiya gaya, jisme revenue tatha police dono ki seema ek hi thi. Exam point: 1798 me Patna ke Magistrate ka kshetra 403 square mile kar diya gaya, jo Fatuha se Maner tak tatha dakshin me Naubatpur tak phaila tha; Gaya ka Magistrate door hone ke kaaran karwai der se hoti thi; aage 1825 me alag Patna jile bana.

qe: The parganas of Bihar and Rajgir were transferred from the district of Bihar to the district of Patna in which year?
qh: बिहार तथा राजगीर के परगने बिहार जिले से पटना जिले को किस वर्ष हस्तांतरित किए गए?
e: 1825 me Patna ek alag jile ke roop me banaya gaya, jisme revenue tatha police dono ki seema ek hi tarah rakhi gayi. Lekin us samay bhi Bihar tatha Rajgir ke pargane is naye jile me shamil nahi the; woh aage tak alag Bihar jile ka hissa rahe. Yah do pargane 1865 me Bihar jile se nikal kar Patna jile me shamil kiye gaye, tab ja kar aaj ke Patna jile ka roop poora hua. Aise badlav dikhate hain ki jilon ki seemayein sthir nahi hoti thi; colonial prashasan apni suvidha tatha apradh par nazar rakhne ke liye inhe baar-baar badalta raha tha. Exam point: Patna jila 1825 me alag bana tatha uski revenue-police seema ek hi rakhi gayi; Bihar tatha Rajgir ke pargane 1865 me Bihar jile se Patna jile me aaye; angreji kaal me jilon ki seemayein baar-baar badalti rahin.
